project.title: Glycerol consuming bacteria in anaerobic condition raw sequence reads
project.description: This project aimed to screen effective glycerol consuming and 1,3-propanodiol producing mixed culture from four different inoculant sources including activated sludge from WWTP, freshwater lake sediment, rainforest soil and mangrove sediment
